Title: Log Analytics Linux Agent for Fall 2020 now available

Body.Content:
The Log Analytics Linux Agent for Fall 2020 is now available. This release contains support for Python 3, additional distro support, and a new troubleshooting tool.

If you have installed the Log Analytics agent for Linux by using Azure extensions and have automatic extension updates turned on, this update will be automatically applied. Otherwise, you can use the latest installer available in the agent GitHub repo, version 1.13.27. 

For more information, see the agent release notes.
